ابتهجتم (form VIII)
# اِبْتَهَجْتُمْ (ibtahajtum) /ib.ta.had͡ʒ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# اُبْتُهِجْتُمْ (ubtuhijtum) /ub.tu.hid͡ʒ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
